name: Speed and Love
description: After her parents' divorce, Jiang Mu reunites with her adopted brother Jin Chao, now a hardened young man living a dangerous life in Thailand. Despite their growing distance, Jiang Mu's unwavering love helps bridge the gap between them, leading to a journey of healing and redemption as they fight to rebuild their bond and face their struggles together.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Jiang Mu flees her mother’s control, traveling to Thailand to visit her father. She bonds with Nana on the flight and reunites with a serious, changed Jin Zhao at the airport.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Jiang Mu tails Jin Zhao to an underground fight, discovering his secret life and hidden burdens.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Jin Zhao opens up about his tragic past, and Jiang Mu finally glimpses the man behind the fighter.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Jiang Mu celebrates Jin Zhao’s birthday, staying by his side and sharing warmth amid his lonely past. Their bond strengthens, and she begins to see him as more than just a friend.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Jiang Mu decides to stay in Nanjing to pursue her studies, drawn by the city and her growing attachment to Jin Zhao. She investigates his life, curious about the man behind her memories.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: At a party, Jiang Mu is drugged and vulnerable. Jin Zhao intervenes, confronting the man responsible and proving his protective instincts, leaving Jiang Mu shaken but safe.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Jiang Mu and Jin Zhao share secrets, building trust. Amid family struggles, they support each other, teasing and testing boundaries while growing closer emotionally.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Jiang Mu worries about Jin Zhao’s romantic life, spying on his interactions. She grows jealous, realizing her feelings for him are stronger than she expected.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Jiang Mu protects Jin Zhao from pressure at the garage, teasing and provoking him to show his confidence. She begins adapting to life in Thailand, practicing driving and gaining independence.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: In the rain, Jiang Mu practices drawing car patterns, subtly signaling her feelings. A spark passes between her and Jin Zhao, hinting at the start of a deeper connection.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Jiang Mu expresses her feelings at the seaside. Jin Zhao silently supports her, showing care without words. Their bond strengthens amid high-stakes racing and emotional tension.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Jiang Mu finds the keychain she’s been searching for, symbolizing her connection to Jin Zhao. Emotional closure brings her one step closer to acknowledging her love.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Jiang Mu gifts Jin Zhao a heart-shaped drift pattern. Their playful driving and shared time at the temple festival highlight a blossoming romance.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Celebrating Jin Zhao’s racing victory, Jiang Mu gets drunk and kisses him. The moment reveals suppressed emotions and deepening attraction.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Jin Zhao confirms their relationship, giving Jiang Mu a treasured jade pendant. Their childhood bond transforms into romantic intimacy.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Jiang Mu and Jin Zhao’s relationship is noticed by others, complicating matters. Their connection grows stronger despite social scrutiny.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Jiang Mu worries for Jin Zhao’s safety during risky races. He reassures her while facing danger, showing his courage and responsibility.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Driving together, Jiang Mu and Jin Zhao envision a shared future. Their playful time on the road strengthens intimacy.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Jiang Mu tries to reach Jin Zhao during a dangerous event but loses contact. She risks everything to signal him, showcasing devotion.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Jiang Mu leaves for Canada to care for her mother, reluctantly parting with Jin Zhao. He struggles with recovery while keeping his distance to protect her future.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Jiang Mu investigates Jin Zhao’s past, piecing together clues from friends and contacts. Curiosity fuels her determination to reconnect.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: Jiang Mu finally reunites with Jin Zhao at his café. Their cautious interaction is filled with mixed emotions and tentative steps toward reconciliation.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: Jiang Mu probes Jin Zhao, testing boundaries. Playful teasing masks lingering hurt and unresolved feelings.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: Jiang Mu learns the truth about Jin Zhao’s accident. Emotional revelations allow them to bridge years of misunderstanding.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Jin Zhao brings Jiang Mu home for Mid-Autumn festival. Their intimacy deepens as they share life updates and reflect on their growth.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: Jin Zhao and Jiang Mu reconcile, revisiting memories and embracing a shared future. Past grievances dissolve.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: Jin Zhao announces his intention to marry Jiang Mu, surprising friends and family during a celebratory dinner.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: Jin Zhao visits Jiang Mu’s family to formally propose. Tensions with her mother slowly ease as understanding grows.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: After a heartfelt family reunion, Jin Zhao finally proposes to Jiang Mu, sealing years of love and longing.
